name: Graft
description: A crossed physical model: breath, bow, mallet or pluck set on a string, a stopped pipe, a bar or a bowl, sixteen instruments from two choices.

params.name: Exciter
params.description: What sets the body going. Breath and Bow hold a note for as long as the key is down; Mallet and Pluck strike once and let it ring. Applies to the next note.

params.name: Body
params.description: What rings. String has every harmonic, Pipe is hollow with the odd ones, Bar has the spread partials of metal or wood, Bowl beats slowly. Applies to the next note.

params.name: Pressure
params.description: How hard the body is driven: breath or bow force, or the weight of the strike. More is louder and brighter. A struck note keeps the weight it was struck with.

params.name: Position
params.description: Where the body is excited, from the end to the middle. Near the end is thin with many partials; the middle is round and hollow. A struck bar or bowl keeps its place.

params.name: Bright
params.description: How long the high partials live against the low ones. Low is wood or felt, dull soon after the start; high is metal that stays bright as it rings.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long the body rings once the exciter stops. For a struck or plucked note it is the whole length of the note.

params.name: Air
params.description: The noise of the exciter: breath in the tone, rosin under the bow, the thud of a mallet, the scrape of a pluck. It also keeps a blown or bowed bar or bowl shimmering.

params.name: Swell
params.description: How long Breath and Bow take to speak. Short starts at once; long lets each note rise slowly out of nothing. Mallet and Pluck ignore it.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the body may keep ringing after the key is let go. Short damps it like a hand laid on it; long leaves it to its own Decay.

params.name: Wander
params.description: Slow life in pitch, level and tone, different for every note, so held notes drift a little against each other and never stand still.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the sound is spread between left and right: the partials of each note, and the notes themselves across the keyboard. At zero the instrument is mono.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Four exciters (a soft flow curve, a stick and slip friction curve, a mallet pulse, a pluck) each drive one of four bodies (a waveguide string, a waveguide stopped at one end, the modes of a free bar, the beating mode pairs of a bowl). The exciters meet the body at one point only and the bodies are idealised; it is not a model of any one instrument or product.
